A line comment you are writing now stands apart from the lines it is on, and a long one wraps instead of being cut off.

- The comment field (diff pane, and the preview pane's source view `c`) now spans the pane's full width, its `Line N:` label reaching out into the line-number column, and sits on a shaded background when desk-look can read your terminal theme, so what you type no longer reads like another line of the document
- A comment longer than one line wraps over the field's three rows. Before, the field sat indented with `Clear` and `Cancel` beside it, narrower than the width Claude Code wraps it to, so the text stopped at `…` on the first row. `Clear` and `Cancel` now sit on the row below
- desk-asana, desk-slack, desk-plan and desk-review move to 0.81.2 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
